text:
An object emits infrared radiation.
Which two properties of the object determine the rate of radiation of thermal energy from the
object?
A
the density and the surface area of the object
B
the density and the surface temperature of the object
C
the mass and the surface area of the object
D
the surface area and the surface temperature of the object

options.label: A
options.text: the density and the surface area of the object

options.label: B
options.text: the density and the surface temperature of the object

options.label: C
options.text: the mass and the surface area of the object

options.label: D
options.text: the surface area and the surface temperature of the object
